description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for the fsmonitor daemon backend, including path classification, batch management, and daemon state handling.

classes.name: fsmonitor_daemon_state
classes.description: Structure holding the state of the fsmonitor daemon, including thread handles, synchronization primitives, path buffers, and error codes.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__new
methods.description: Creates a new batch of paths to monitor.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__free_list
methods.description: Frees a list of fsmonitor batches starting from the given batch.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__add_path
methods.description: Adds a path to the specified batch of modified files.

methods.name: fsmonitor_classify_path_workdir_relative
methods.description: Classifies a relative path within the working directory.

methods.name: fsmonitor_classify_path_gitdir_relative
methods.description: Classifies a relative path within an external GITDIR.

methods.name: fsmonitor_classify_path_absolute
methods.description: Classifies an absolute path received from filesystem events.

methods.name: fsmonitor_publish
methods.description: Publishes a batch of paths associated with a token to worker threads.

methods.name: fsmonitor_force_resync
methods.description: Invalidates cached data and aborts waiting threads if filesystem sync is lost.
